Name: Snehal Shah
Designation: Independent Director, Gala Precision Engineering Ltd
Bio:
Snehal Shah is a Founder of Plaksha. He holds a Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering from Sardar Patel University and a Postgraduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) with a specialization in Finance from the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore.

He has over 21 years of experience in private equity, having held senior roles at ICICI Venture, Actis, and Fairwinds. In 2016, he stepped away from active corporate life to explore personal interests such as trekking and travel. Recently, Snehal has taken up a board role as an Independent Director at Gala Precision Engineering Limited, where he brings his extensive industry insight and strategic acumen.
